Slides-Align: Human Preference Rankings for AI-Generated Presentations
	

Project Page | Paper | GitHub


	
		
	
	
		Overview
	

Slides-Align is a human preference dataset for evaluating AI-generated slide presentations, introduced as part of the SlidesGen-Bench framework. It contains 1,326 human rankings comparing presentations generated by 9 different AI slide generation products across 7 scenario categories and 187 unique topics.
